sources.quote: As a result of our efficiency improvements, we are also lowering the price of these models to $2 / 1M input tokens and $10 / 1M output tokens.
sources.supports: xAI itself announced the Grok 2 model rates as $2 input and $10 output per million tokens.
The provider's API model record has a cached prompt price field, with zero for grok-2-vision-1212; it has no cache-write price field in its documented model pricing schema.

sources.quote: * `cachedPromptTokenPrice` (string) — The price (in USD cents) per 100 million cached prompt tokens.
sources.supports: xAI documents its cache price as a cached-prompt-token price, not as a separate cache-write rate.

notes: The documented $2/$10 rates match the unchanged input/output values in the models.dev record. xAI's model record exposes cached prompt pricing (shown as zero for Grok 2 Vision) but no cache-write rate, so the removed cache_write entry is best classified as a models.dev correction; the cited sources do not establish a historical cache-read price or an effective date. The Internet Archive CDX request for archived pricing material returned HTTP 503, so no archive snapshot pair was available.
